#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; uniform vec4 inputColor; in vec2 fragCoord; const float radius = 0.5; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float dist = distance(center, fragCoord.xy); float pixelDist = fwidth(dist) * 1.0; float smoothAlpha = 1.0 - clamp((dist - (radius - pixelDist)) / pixelDist, 0.0, 1.0); FragColor = vec4(inputColor.xyz, smoothAlpha); }
